# MilkDrop Resource Archives

This folder vendors the recommended preset and texture packs used by
`tools/install-milkdrop-resources.ps1`, so normal resource installation does not
depend on downloading from GitHub at install time.

The archives are pinned snapshots of these upstream repositories:

| Archive | Upstream repository | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presets-cream-of-the-crop-0180df21f5e0.zip` | `projectM-visualizer/presets-cream-of-the-crop` | `0180df21f5e0bd39b9060cc5de420ed2f1f9e509` |
| `presets-milkdrop-original-e03b83e3338d.zip` | `projectM-visualizer/presets-milkdrop-original` | `e03b83e3338d8f1ed6cbcf908c719f249ef24288` |
| `presets-milkdrop-texture-pack-ff8edf2a8fa0.zip` | `projectM-visualizer/presets-milkdrop-texture-pack` | `ff8edf2a8fa07e55ad562f1af97076526c484f7d` |

These files are third-party preset resources. Keep upstream attribution and
license/readme files intact inside each archive when updating them.
